input.description: Input parameters for the text-to-image task.

examples: A cinematic night city poster with neon reflections on a rainy street.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image is set to auto by default. The 27:16, 16:27, 9:8 and 8:9 aspect ratios support 1K only. 2K and 4K are available for other aspect ratios.

background.description: For 2K/4K tasks, background=transparent must be paired with the prompt: describe an isolated subject with no backdrop, scenery or shadow, and for image-to-image explicitly ask to extract the subject and keep the background transparent.
